title: Tidal Pavilion
alt: Quiet coastal reading pavilion with pale concrete walls, an oak bench and a large opening framing the Atlantic
overview: A small reading pavilion imagined at the edge of a dune landscape. Its purpose is simple: offer shelter, a place to sit and an uninterrupted relationship with the sea. The architecture makes room for the horizon.
approach: A deep opening turns the changing light into the main event. Board-formed concrete gives the outside a quiet weight; cork and oak soften the reading alcove within. The compact footprint is a study in doing less while giving more attention to place.
